text: Coinbase is a secure platform for buying, selling, and storing cryptocurrency. FDIC-insured USD balances up to $250,000. Your funds are protected with industry-leading security. Regulated by state money transmitter licenses. Cryptocurrency is not FDIC insured and may lose value.

Binance is the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume. Advanced trading features with spot, margin, and futures. Proof of Reserves verified. Risk Warning: Cryptocurrency trading involves significant risks.

Kraken is a US-based cryptocurrency exchange founded in 2011. Bank-level security with 95% of assets in cold storage. FinCEN registered and regulated. Past performance does not guarantee future results.
Gemini is a regulated cryptocurrency exchange and custodian. SOC 2 Type 2 certified. NYDFS regulated. Your assets are protected with insurance coverage. Cryptocurrency value can fluctuate.
Crypto.com provides trading, payments, and financial services for cryptocurrency. ISO 27001 certified. SOC 2 Type 2 compliant. Regulatory licenses in multiple jurisdictions.
Bitstamp is Europe's longest-standing cryptocurrency exchange. Luxembourg-licensed virtual currency exchange. Full compliance with EU regulations. Cryptocurrency investments carry risk.
Bitso is Latin America's leading cryptocurrency exchange. Regulated in multiple countries. Bank-level security protocols. Your funds are protected. Cryptocurrency values may decrease.
CoinDCX is India's largest cryptocurrency exchange. ISO 27001 certified. FIU-IND registered. Advanced security with multi-layer protection. Investment in crypto assets involves risk.
Chase Bank offers checking, savings, mortgages, and credit cards. FDIC insured up to $250,000. Member FDIC. Equal Housing Lender. JPMorgan Chase & Co.
Bank of America provides banking, investing, and mortgage services. FDIC insured. Member FDIC. Equal Housing Lender. Merrill Lynch wealth management.
Fidelity Investments offers brokerage, retirement, and wealth management. SIPC protected up to $500,000. SEC registered. Not FDIC insured, investments may lose value.
Charles Schwab provides brokerage, banking, and financial advisory services. SIPC member. SEC registered investment adviser. Your investments may lose value.
Vanguard offers low-cost index funds and ETFs. SIPC member. SEC registered. Investments are subject to market risk. Past performance is not a guarantee.
TD Ameritrade provides investment and trading services. SIPC protected. SEC registered broker-dealer. Investments involve risk including loss of principal.
E*TRADE offers brokerage and banking services. SIPC member. FDIC insured bank accounts. Morgan Stanley company. Investments may lose value.
Wells Fargo provides banking, mortgage, and investment services. FDIC insured. NMLS ID 399801. Investment products are not FDIC insured.
Citibank offers personal banking and credit card services. FDIC insured. Member FDIC. Equal Housing Lender. Citigroup company.
Capital One provides banking, credit cards, and auto loans. FDIC insured. Member FDIC. Equal Housing Lender.
